title: Segment plan
description: One segment of a route as the state machine sees it: a transition of a nondeterministic automaton from one (node, asset) pair to another, at one provider (REQ-STM-7). A transition that changes no value is allowed. Schemas that embed this shape close it themselves with unevaluatedProperties.

segment_id.description: Unique within its order. Inputs name a segment by this id, never by position, so a report about a segment a recalculation replaced matches nothing current.

provider.description: The provider the segment runs at.

endpoint.description: A vertex of the automaton: a node and an asset.
